stance_basis: paraphrased as finding no conflict with state plans or priorities
summary: The Illinois Department of Conservation participated in the Illinois State Clearinghouse review of the F.A.P. 23 (Lincoln Highway) reconstruction project. The review, which included the Department of Conservation among other state agencies, found that the proposal does not conflict with any plans, programs, or priorities of any cognizant State agency. No specific objections or conditions were raised by the Department of Conservation.
complaint_summary: The Illinois Department of Conservation, as one of several state agencies reviewing the proposal through the Illinois State Clearinghouse, found no conflict between the project and any state agency plans, programs, or priorities.
summary_quote: The review indicates that the proposal does not conflict with any of the plans, programs, or priorities of any cognizant State agency.
